title: State-of-the-art and perspectives of hydrogen generation from waste plastics
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00604F, Review Article

Feng Niu, Zeqi Wu, Da Chen, Yuexiang Huang, Vitaly V. Ordomsky, Andrei Y. Khodakov, Kevin M. Van Geem
This review provides a comprehensive analysis of hydrogen production through plastic waste upcycling, covering both established and emerging technologies, and addressing their feasibility and commercialization challenges.
